seo_title: Wedding Videographer & Photographer Derby | Zen Visuals
seo_description: Wedding films and photography in Derby by Zuzia and Ben, 15 minutes away in Belper. Whole day from £1,000, 5.0 from 22 Google reviews. Check your date.
h1: Wedding videographer and photographer in Derby
hero_alt: Bride and groom facing each other under a green bandstand
intro: Derby is fifteen minutes down the A6 from us in Belper, so it's where we film and photograph more weddings than anywhere else. We're Zuzia and Ben, a husband-and-wife team, and we cover your whole day for one price, from getting ready to the last dance.
Whether you're marrying in the city, at a country house on its edge or in one of the villages along the Derwent, we know the roads, the light and the places that make a good photograph.

sections.heading: Weddings around Derby
sections.text: We've photographed and filmed at West Mill in Darley Abbey, and couples getting married around Derby also choose venues such as Makeney Hall, Morley Hayes, Breadsall Priory, Darley Abbey Mills and the city's churches and registry office. Wherever you're marrying, tell us the venue and we'll tell you if we know it.

sections.heading: What you get
sections.text: Wedding photography of your whole day is £1,000. A 3–6 minute wedding film is £1,400. Both together are £2,200, saving £200. Your photographs and film are ready within 3 to 6 weeks.

sections.heading: How we work on the day
sections.text: We blend in. Most of your guests won't notice us, and the moments we're after are the real ones: nerves in the morning, the reactions during the vows, the speeches, the dance floor. With two of us, one on photographs and one on film, every angle is covered.

sections.heading: Fifteen minutes from home
sections.text: Derby is on our doorstep, and so are Belper, Duffield, Allestree, Littleover, Mickleover, Spondon and Chaddesden. We know the venues, the roads and where the light is good at every time of day.

faqs.question: Are you local to Derby?
faqs.answer: Yes. We're based in Belper, fifteen minutes up the A6, and Derby is where we film and photograph more weddings than anywhere else.

faqs.question: How much does a wedding videographer cost in Derby?
faqs.answer: Our wedding film is £1,400 for your whole day. Photography and film together is £2,200, saving £200.

faqs.question: Which Derby wedding venues have you worked at?
faqs.answer: We've worked at West Mill in Darley Abbey, and at Shottle Hall nearby. If you're marrying somewhere else, tell us the venue and we'll let you know if we've been.

faqs.question: How far ahead should we book?
faqs.answer: Popular dates in summer and early autumn go a year or more ahead. Half of the price secures your date, so it's worth checking as soon as you have one.
